rows.title: Root index.html now redirects; the requirements workflow will fail its clean-diff check on its next run
rows.detail: Root index.html was replaced with a redirect to site/index.html (17 Nov). scripts/build_site.py regenerates the legacy root index.html on every run. .github/workflows/requirements.yml runs build_site.py and then fails if git diff is not empty. Tested in a scratch copy: with the legacy index committed the regenerated file is identical; with the redirect committed the regenerated legacy dashboard differs. The workflow runs only on pushes or PRs touching requirements/**, scripts/build_site.py, scripts/check_links.py, or the workflow file, so this PR does not trigger it. The requirements session (f6e60a81) must decide the fix: stop build_site.py writing index.html, or keep the redirect and exempt it from the diff check.
